_note: English -> Vietnamese glossary for the translation stage, counterpart of translation_glossary_zh.json.
Matching is WHOLE-WORD and case-insensitive (unlike the Han glossary, which matches on substrings),
so 'war' will not fire inside 'warm'. Only entries whose term appears in the current line are injected.
Keep it lean — a capable model already handles ordinary English. Only add: (1) film-specific ranks,
units, organisations and codenames that need one fixed Vietnamese form, (2) terms of address the model
renders inconsistently, (3) names it mangles or over-translates.
Do NOT add ordinary vocabulary or well-known place names; the model handles those, and every extra
entry is prompt budget spent for nothing.
'aliases' are output-side fixes applied AFTER translation and are never sent to the model — use them
to normalise an English word that keeps leaking through untranslated.
